# CCMAF Skills — Engineering (`ccmaf-skills-engineering`)

The cross-cutting engineering disciplines: code review, secure development, test engineering, git workflow, architecture review, legacy modernisation, and Python as the general-purpose glue language.

**Audience:** Every developer, whatever the stack — install alongside core.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add drushegh/CCMAF---Skills
/plugin install ccmaf-skills-engineering@ccmaf-skills
```

Install `ccmaf-skills-core` alongside this pack.
